title: Statement Notes: The Estimate Charge on Reports Filed after an Estimated Assessment
content:
**Note.** On the Employer Unemployment Insurance Tax Accounts, an estimate charge is also added to the late report penalty after the limit. It follows whether an estimated assessment was booked for the quarter of the original report the penalty is worked out from, and how many calendar days after that estimated assessment the report was filed:

| The report's quarter | Report filed | Estimate charge |
|---|---|---|
| Carried an estimated assessment | More than 60 days after the estimated assessment was booked | USD 150.00 |
| Carried an estimated assessment | After it, but no more than 60 days after it | USD 75.00 |
| Never carried an estimated assessment | — | None |

The days are counted in calendar days from the entry date of the estimated assessment booked for that quarter (the latest one, where there is more than one) to the report's filing date.

## Both sides of the 60-day boundary (hypothetical estimate booked on 1 July)

| Report filed | Days after the estimate | Estimate charge |
|---|---|---|
| 30 August | 60 | USD 75.00 |
| 31 August | 61 | USD 150.00 |
| 15 July | 14 | USD 75.00 |

A late report for a quarter that never carried an estimated assessment is charged no estimate charge, however late it is.
